responsibility: This scheduling description models the SPARC M8 core for DFA scheduling. It describes the four-slot issue structure, single-issue barriers, integer, load/store, branch, floating-point, VIS/graphics, crypto-adjacent, and GSR latencies plus selected bypasses, so code generated from generic SPARC patterns can be scheduled according to M8 execution resources rather than the earlier Niagara-family or UltraSPARC models.
